prompt: Create ONE vertical 16-bit pixel-art ALIEN BINARY DATA WALL sprite for the Bullets of Fury campaign map, isolated on genuine transparent background. Static fixed-position wall, no scrolling trail. Restrained 16-bit hard pixels and chunky graphic detail, much less purple than before (at most tiny hints of violet, under 5%). Explicitly NO crystals, diamonds, gems, neon pink or magenta, giant standalone digits, flame, smoke, lightning, circuitry columns, icons, symbols besides 0 and 1, labels, map background, ocean, checkerboard, frames or UI. One complete tall wall panel, no multi-panel contact sheet, no clipping, aspect ratio approximately 1:2.
